subject.title: fix(official): require verified ownership for newly allowlisted official org handles

question: Should this PR be rebased into the current exact-row Official publisher model, or should ClawHub intentionally replace that model with reservation-derived org and personal-publisher Official inheritance?
rationale: This changes a publishing trust boundary and conflicts with the policy already shipped on current main, so automation should not choose the permanent Official-status model.

options.title: Rebase as a row-model patch
options.body: Resolve conflicts, remove the npm lockfile, preserve exact `officialPublishers` rows as the source of truth, and keep current route alias protections.

options.title: Split route cleanup only
options.body: If the Official trust hardening is already covered by current main, close or pause the policy replacement and submit any desired route-reservation additions separately.

options.title: Approve policy replacement
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept reservation-derived Official status after documenting the trust model and upgrade/security behavior.

recommendation.title: Rebase as a row-model patch
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, remove the npm lockfile, preserve exact `officialPublishers` rows as the source of truth, and keep current route alias protections.
